name: Infinity Lancer
storyline:
In the distant future, humans have spread to the stars. Without warning, human colonies are attacked all across the galaxy by an unknown enemy force. No mercy is shown and humanity is on the brink of complete destruction. One final hope remains: the Infinity Lancer program. Using cloned pilots to battle the enemy, each death transfers the memory of one pilot to the next.
With each death comes knowledge that might lead to the survival of humanity and the discovery of the dark truths behind the invasion.
summary: Infinity Lancer is a vertical shoot em' up with a vibrant pixel art style. Battle across the galaxy in seamless stages where the action never stop. Unleash destruction using a selection of unique ships, and rack up high scores with its chain system that ties together hits, bombs, and scoring.
